medicina.titulo: The shape of water at a key tau hotspot helps drive dementia-linked clumping
medicina.resumo: Diseases such as Alzheimer's and frontotemporal dementia are considered neurodegenerative tauopathies, in which tau proteins in the brain misfold and lead to cognitive decline. Until now, it has been unclear how misfolded tau recruits other seemingly healthy tau and causes it to misfold and clump.

medicina.titulo: Study examines long-term mental health and alcohol use trajectories following disasters
medicina.resumo: A study of people who had been exposed to a disaster found different long-term patterns of alcohol use and mental health that were interrelated and influenced by individual differences and the type of disaster they experienced. The study, published in Alcohol: Clinical and Experimental Research, calls attention to the long-term mental and behavioral health challenges of people who have experienced disasters and the need for interventions tailored to their particular mental health profiles to prevent problem drinking.

medicina.titulo: New research shows promise for treating hepatitis C in pregnancy
medicina.resumo: Researchers and clinicians at WashU Medicine are helping reshape how hepatitis C virus (HCV) is treated during pregnancy, with a new study showing that a commonly used antiviral regimen can be used safely and effectively in pregnant patients in real-world care.

medicina.titulo: Experiments reveal how DNA-packaging protein mutation promotes breast cancer spread
medicina.resumo: A research team led by professor Chan Kui-ming from the Department of Biomedical Sciences at CityUHK discovered that H2BE113K, a missense H2B mutation, promotes colony formation and lung metastasis in breast cancer. The research revealed that H2BE113K plays a critical role in chromatin regulation, cellular function and breast cancer progression, shedding light on new targeted therapies for breast cancer.

biologia.titulo: AI platform and database map protein phase separation across species
biologia.resumo: Scientists at Nanyang Technological University, Singapore (NTU Singapore) have developed an AI-powered database and a platform that could enable researchers to more accurately predict which proteins undergo phase separation—a process through which proteins in cells separate like oil droplets in water.

biologia.titulo: DNA reveals genetic divide in Australian brolgas, with southern birds facing greater diversity risks
biologia.resumo: New research on the brolga, an iconic Australian crane species, has shown important genetic differences between northern and southeastern populations, with evidence that those in western Victoria are at increased risk, likely heightened by the loss of wetlands.

biologia.titulo: Scarred blood vessels may be one clue to APOE4’s Alzheimer’s risk
biologia.resumo: Scientists know APOE4 raises Alzheimer’s risk. A surprising change in blood vessel cells may help explain how.

biologia.titulo: 'Molecular sunscreen' may explain why DNA uses thymine despite its vulnerability to UV damage
biologia.resumo: Scientists have long sought to understand the complex origins of intelligent life. It remains unclear how biological systems not only formed but survived and persisted under the extreme conditions of primordial Earth's hostile climate. Now, researchers at Texas A&M University are using light-based technologies to uncover new clues to help solve this evolutionary puzzle.

robotica.resumo: Daifuku's Cecile Dick-Calmes said success is no longer measured solely by automation density or equipment utilization. The post Closing the reality gap: Why real-time execution has become the new competitive advantage appeared first on The Robot Report .

The Maintainers Summit is a one-day, invitation-only gathering of about 30 kernel developers; it is held once each year to discuss policy-related issues that are not always amenable to resolution via email. The 2026 event was scheduled for October 8 in Prague, Czechia. Unsurprisingly, the discussion there was dominated by large language models (LLMs) and their effect on the development community, but some time was also found to talk about security bugs and long-term succession planning.

The LineageOS project, which produces an Android-based distribution for mobile devices, has announced the release of LineageOS 24.0. We're a bit sentimental about this release, as it precedes a really fun upcoming milestone. On December 24, 2026, LineageOS will celebrate 10 years. It's a remarkable milestone for a project built by a passionate community of developers, maintainers, contributors, and users who have kept so many devices alive along the way. [...] We've been hard at work rebasing all of our changes and features since Android 17's release in June. Android 17's first release mainly contained iterative improvements and some UI/UX refinements, but due to our previous efforts adapting to Google's heavy refactoring over the last several versions, we were able to rebase onto Android 17's code-base faster than anticipated. Yes you read that right: We're early this year!

hardware.resumo: Integrated circuits are electronic chips containing the interconnected components that process information or control electrical signals inside many electronic devices. These chips are known to generate heat as they operate, which can affect the safety and performance of electronics.

hardware.resumo: A customer paid approximately $350 for what appeared to be a repairable RTX 4090, only to receive a fake GPU with components that were painstakingly designed to resemble the real thing.

astrofisica.resumo: NASA experiments focused on human and plant health and drug-resistant organisms will travel to the International Space Station aboard SpaceX’s 35th Commercial Resupply Services mission for the agency from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida, advancing research that benefits life on Earth and future exploration. This research supports astronaut health during long-duration missions through […]

astrofisica.titulo: ALMA catches a dying star mid-transformation, with a ring from its last outburst
astrofisica.resumo: Astronomers have used radio observations from the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA) to catch a dying star in the middle of a dramatic transformation, and the data show a ring that records its final outburst. The new research was posted to the arXiv preprint server on Sept. 18. The paper has been accepted for publication in The Astrophysical Journal.

astrofisica.titulo: Alternative gravity theory offers possible explanation for dark energy changing over time
astrofisica.resumo: For many years, the simplest view of dark energy has been that it remains unchanged. Throughout cosmic history, the mysterious ingredient believed to drive the universe's accelerated expansion is thought to have behaved in the same way at every epoch. However, an increasing number of observations are challenging this idea.

astrofisica.titulo: Physics Nobel highlights Antarctica's role in exploring the cosmos
astrofisica.resumo: When Belgian American particle physicist Francis Halzen was awarded the 2026 Nobel Prize in physics "for decisive contributions to the IceCube Neutrino Observatory and the discovery of high-energy neutrinos of astrophysical origin," it was a reminder that for more than a century, scientists have treated Antarctica's environments as windows onto worlds beyond Earth.

quantica.resumo: Researchers from Rutgers, IBM and collaborating institutions have shown that a quantum computer can check what is happening inside it and respond while it is running, repeatedly resetting parts of the system to bring chaotic behavior under control.

computadores_pessoais.titulo: Your SSD might be lying about its storage capacity. Here’s how to check
computadores_pessoais.resumo: If you buy an external SSD or a USB stick today that’s being offered at a bargain price with astronomical storage capacities, you should be rather skeptical. The reason: The market is currently being flooded with sophisticated counterfeit storage devices. Manipulated controller firmware can trick the operating system into believing the device has more capacity than physically exists. Here’s an example: Imagine you’ve bought a supposed 4TB SSD on a well-known online platform and your Windows Explorer also displays this capacity. In reality, however, the drive contains only a comparatively tiny 64GB chip. The insidious thing about this manipulation is that the controller has been programmed to appear to acknowledge write operations successfully, even when the physical storage has long since been exhausted. External storage devices with huge capacities at bargain prices sound too good to be true – and in many cases, they are. It’s better to rely on products from brand-name manufacturers. inteligencia_artificial.titulo: Meet the Anthropic Engineer Keeping Its AI Agent Trustworthy
inteligencia_artificial.resumo: If you’ve ever wondered how Claude and similar AI agents can answer complex questions in seconds and where they get the information, you’re not alone. Gurmeet Saran works to find that answer every day as an engineer at Anthropic in San Francisco, the AI research company behind Claude. The IEEE senior member is developing an infrastructure to understand the mechanics behind the chatbot’s behavior and to ensure its underlying architecture produces reliable outputs. energia_materiais.titulo: O que significa o ícone de escudo na bateria do Samsung Galaxy?
energia_materiais.resumo: O ícone de escudo ao lado da bateria em um celular Samsung Galaxy pode parecer um alerta de segurança, mas sua função está relacionada à preservação da bateria. O símbolo indica que a “ Proteção da bateria” está ativa no aparelho. Os celulares atuais usam baterias de íons de lítio, que sofrem desgaste natural ao longo do tempo. Manter o componente em 100% de carga por períodos prolongados pode acelerar esse processo, especialmente quando o aparelho permanece conectado à tomada por muitas horas. Para reduzir o desgaste, a Samsung oferece recursos que controlam o carregamento de acordo com o modo escolhido. As opções disponíveis podem variar conforme o modelo do Galaxy e a versão da One UI, inclusive em alguns modelos Galaxy, os recursos de “Proteção da bateria” podem vir ativados por padrão de fábrica. Como funciona a proteção da bateria nos celulares Galaxy? Quando a “Proteção da bateria” está ativada, o sistema modifica o carregamento para reduzir o tempo em que a bateria permanece em níveis elevados. energia_materiais.titulo: Zinc-air batteries gain new momentum with long-lasting catalyst
energia_materiais.resumo: Zinc-air batteries can store significantly more energy than lithium-ion batteries, but until now have been virtually impossible to recharge. A team led by Professor Jörg J. Schneider from the Department of Chemistry has now demonstrated how a material made of iron, nickel and carbon enables the battery to be charged and discharged up to 500 times.

energia_materiais.titulo: Scientists discover a hidden factor that can make or break chemical reactions
energia_materiais.resumo: Researchers discovered a hidden factor that can determine whether chemical reactions succeed or fail, and then used it to boost the proportion of the desired product from 16% to 97%. By controlling acidity near electrodes, they developed a promising way to manufacture chemicals for plastics, medicines, and other products using oxygen and electricity instead of hazardous added oxidants.

energia_materiais.titulo: Scientists make stunning discovery that could help explain why life exists
energia_materiais.resumo: Scientists have discovered that the universe's fundamental physical constants may be finely balanced to make life possible. Even tiny changes to these constants could make liquids too thick or too thin for essential biological processes, potentially preventing life as we know it. Surprisingly, these life-friendly conditions existed billions of years before living cells appeared. The findings raise intriguing questions about why the laws of physics seem so well suited to life.
